location_description:
Tanglewilde is a census-designated place (CDP) in Thurston County, Washington, United States, part of the Urban Growth Area of the city of Lacey. The population was 6,265 at the 2020 census.


== Geography ==
Tanglewilde is located at 47°3′6″N 122°46′53″W (47.051718, -122.781491).According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 1.5 square miles (3.8 km2), all of it land.
